data.name: CardTitle
data.comment: The title of the Settings card with the Rate and Send feedback buttons (a noun: what users tell the developer).

data.name: CardCaptionFormat
data.value: {0} opens its page in the Microsoft Store. {1} opens GitHub in your browser. 10Lapse sends nothing itself.
data.comment: The text under the Feedback card's title. {0} the Rate button's label (RateButton, "Rate 10Lapse"), {1} the Send feedback button's label (FeedbackButton).

data.name: RateButton
data.comment: A button on the Feedback card that opens 10Lapse's review page in the Microsoft Store; also its screen reader name. Keep it to about 18 characters: it sits beside Send feedback, and both move under the text in a narrow window.

data.name: FeedbackButton
data.comment: A button on the Feedback card that opens the project's GitHub issues in the browser; also its screen reader name. Keep it to about 18 characters.

data.name: RateFailed
data.value: The Microsoft Store didn't open. Open the Store yourself and search for 10Lapse to rate it.
data.comment: A message bar when the Store would not open.

data.name: FeedbackFailed
data.value: Your browser didn't open. Go to github.com/sven-borden/10Lapse/issues to send your feedback.
data.comment: A message bar when the browser would not open. Keep the address as it is.

data.name: Question
data.comment: The heading of a card in the finished state after an export, asking whether the user likes the app. Narrator reads it as the card appears.

data.name: Yes
data.comment: A button on that card: opens the Microsoft Store rating dialog.

data.name: No
data.comment: A button on that card: closes it, nothing else.
